reason: We already have renders and plan packages coming out of our architect and design team, and I'm in a truck between lots all day, so I'm not adding another vendor to chase. At $1,500 a home across a library of plans it adds up fast, and I don't see why I'd pay it on top of what's already covered.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? $500 a round on top adds up, and in spec and semi-custom we tweak plans constantly, so I can't tell what a home really costs me.
would_change_my_mind: A flat per-plan price that covers every option and revision on that plan, so I pay once for the plan and reuse it across every lot and buyer.
